doc.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019

title: Meeting John Surman in England
summary: He met the 16-year-old baritone player John Surman and played with him in Plymouth, where Mike Westbrook also played.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Did you run into John Surman in England?
He played a mean baritone sax, didn’t he? © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

He did. Even then, he was 16 and we connected, the first time it was not in Southampton, Plymouth. So we played together in Plymouth at the art museum or the art school, something like that. Mike Westbrook played there too at that time.
